rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a break in a seminar, session, meeting, or assembly.

example.english: There is an intermission halfway through the seminar, so everyone can go out for a drink of water.
example.traditional: 個講座去到一半有休息時間，大家可以出去飲杯水。
example.jyutping: go3 gong2 zo6 heoi3 dou3 jat1 bun3 jau5 jau1 sik1 si4 gaan3 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 heoi3 jam2 bui1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the interval between halves or acts of a performance or event.

example.english: During the intermission, the players go back into the changing room.
example.traditional: 中場休息嗰陣，球員就返入更衣室。
example.jyutping: zung1 coeng4 jau1 sik1 go2 zan6 kau4 jyun4 zau6 faan1 jap6 gang1 ji1 sat1
